cost: Closed lookup O(n*C*wordbytes), C fixed table size; Capitals guard can scan whole sentence per hit. ending delegates dictionary/morph. postverbal_not O(n²) ancestry worst case, O(1) extra beyond lowercased word. Registry initialized once; no training.
description: Archaic closed-word guards, dictionary-backed ending fallback, annotation repair and postverbal negation reattachment.
forward: entry picks first case-folded form; closed applies contextual guard; force takes closed tag before ending. tagged additionally matches tag and can select second thine reading. ending rejects non-ASCII letters, interior capitalization, any closed/dictionary-known form, then asks morph::ending_verb. fix chooses tagged or matching ending, selects final UPOS, removes illegal features and changes non-be Cop to Aux.
inverse: R(force tags) includes all spellings/context sentences satisfying the selected guard and lowercased table match; unknown words also map None. fix loses original feature bits rejected by allowed and original non-be Cop vs Aux; neither repaired tuple nor moved-count uniquely restores old annotation.
limitations: Dictionary-sensitive ending_rule and fix_follows_the_registry excluded (can early-return)
Registry-dependent fix and dictionary ending not newly measured
Mismatched arrays/invalid head indices can panic; preexisting cycles not repaired
state: Ordered CLOSED entries, token forms/tags/upos/head/relations, embedded registry OnceLock and dictionary.
